entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Tensor.Create Throws on strides #117855
  • API compat error for `DisableGeneratedCodeHeuristics` in ILLink #117854
  • [API Proposal]: Add File.Delete and Directory.Delete overloads that specify not found throw behavior #117853
  • TypeLoadException for mutually-referencing generic **struct**s that contain no data fields #117852
  • [WASI] .NET 10 Preview 6: wasi-experimental Console app generated by 'dotnet new wasiconsole' cannot run #117848

Closed

  • Slow tcp reading on Linux unlike Windows 11 #117193
    Future

PullRequests

Created

  • Use big endian buffers instead of BigInteger for RSA ASN types #117851
    area-System.Security
  • Couple of small cryptography refactorings #117850
    area-System.Security
  • Use HashSet/SearchValues when known OID list is long #117849
    area-System.Security
  • Fix ML-DSA PKCS8 copying bug #117847
    area-System.Security, 10.0.0
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #117845
    area-codeflow
  • Make `ExceptionHandling.RaiseAppDomainUnhandledExceptionEvent()` thread safe. #117844
    area-System.Runtime.InteropServices, 10.0.0

Merged

  • Switch to Azure Linux Arm64 Helix VM hosts #117790
    needs-area-label

    area-Diagnostics-coreclr, area-NativeAOT-coreclr, 10.0.0

    area-Diagnostics-coreclr, 10.0.0

    area-ExceptionHandling-coreclr, 10.0.0
  • disable multicast tests on AzureLinux #117694
    area-System.Net.Sockets, test-run-core, 10.0.0

    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Make dotnet --info print all DOTNET_* and COREHOST_* environment variables #117797
    area-Host, 10.0.0
  • Tune CCMP for better Perf #116445
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
